verdict.rationale: Kling documents cheaper 'std' and pricier 'pro' generation modes and native 4K output, but nothing shows a chosen draft take being upscaled or promoted to final quality. Rerunning in pro mode produces a new generation, not an upscale of the selected take, so the tiered modes are only adjacent to this workflow.

support.subject: As a creator, I can draft fast in a cheaper mode and upscale the chosen take to final quality
